verdict.rationale: No evidence of any API/console-driven distribution or logistics service for shipping keys to distributed employees; documentation only covers end-user setup, pairing, and reset, and the probe explicitly notes Titan has no vendor CLI/SDK/API for fleet management, with such logistics handled (if at all) by a separate product. missing for 10: any evidence of bulk-ordering/shipping API, distributor/logistics integration, or console-driven key provisioning to employees.
